name: Trigger Homes
summary: Set a home and travel back to it or to the world spawn with simple chat commands that work without operator rights.
logoPrompt: A small cosy cabin with a glowing window and a red bed beside a swirling purple portal frame, standing on a grass block, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Home and spawn, one command away.

description: **Trigger Homes gives every player a home they can return to with one chat command, even on servers where nobody else has operator rights.**
- `/trigger sethome` saves the block you stand on as your home, one home per player.
- `/trigger home` takes you back there, also from another dimension: a home in the Nether works from the Overworld.
- `/trigger spawn` takes you to the world spawn.
- A 30-second cooldown after each teleport, and a message that tells you how long to wait.

Put the zip into the `datapacks` folder of your world (or pick it when you create a new world). Stand where you want your home, type `/trigger sethome`, then use `/trigger home` whenever you want to go back.
- Made for Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21, 1.21.1 and 26.3. Players need nothing installed.
- Homes can be set in the Overworld, the Nether and the End. A new home replaces the old one.
- The teleport does not check for danger: if your home is later filled with lava, you land in it.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
